requiredAcceptance.requirement: Every emitted notification intent maps to one complete decision-table row and one exact event type.
The reserved source is accepted only for the sealed exact event-type set; every other source-event pair fails closed.
Recipients are deterministically derived, actor/self exclusions are applied, and the final direct-recipient set contains 1 through 100 active authorized users.
Envelope hints contain no rendered body, sensitive HR value, raw destination, provider data, secret, arbitrary URL, file path or object bytes.
typeKey, owner app hcm, APP.HCM:VIEW entitlement, template version/model digest, locale and variable allowlist are exact and registered.
The selected typed receipt strategy preserves tenant, producer event and intent identity and rejects mismatched or replay-conflicting evidence.
People persists the business fact and outbox handoff atomically; retries are idempotent and do not send directly to a channel provider.
Transport, feature, tenant and customer activation remain OFF; missing configuration, template or authority returns a bounded failure and never a false success.

requiredEvidence: completed decision table with exact schema and template pins
changed-path manifest proving central and module ownership separation
eight acceptance results with command, test count and zero skipped mandatory cases
receipt binding, idempotency and fail-closed evidence
